about.title: About Me
bio: I'm a Tech Lead specialized in fintech payment platforms and multi-tenant systems.
I've built and scaled payment infrastructure across Latin American markets.
I've led teams of 5+ engineers with a focus on event-driven architecture, clean architecture, and CI/CD automation using TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
I care about shipping reliable software — and about the tooling, pipelines, and code review culture that make teams faster.

cards.title: Loopay Suite
cards.summary: Multi-tenant, cloud-native fintech payments platform for Latin American markets.
bullets: Lead a team of 5 engineers — architecture decisions, code reviews, and production support (NestJS, React, PostgreSQL, AWS ECS, Terraform).
Built SOBERANA, the deploy monorepo orchestrating Loopay Suite production infrastructure: Terraform IaC for AWS (S3, Lambda, Secrets Manager, ECR), GitHub Actions CI/CD, and local Docker.
Built LoopayOCR, compliance document management with Google Gemini OCR, dynamic Pydantic schema validation, S3 storage, and webhook notifications.

cards.title: Galgo
cards.summary: Motorcycle e-commerce with embedded financing in Colombia.
bullets: Backend services for checkout, lending, and risk evaluation on event-driven microservices (NestJS, AWS).
Cut risk-evaluation latency from minutes to seconds with an event-driven architecture and query performance work.
Built 2 new microservices and maintained 4–5 across checkout, lending, and risk pipelines — cloud infrastructure and observability with Terraform, Datadog, and GitHub Actions.

cards.title: Trebet
cards.summary: Mobile super-app for residential communities — payments, digital intercom, amenity bookings, and assembly voting, with real-time built on WebRTC and WebSockets.
bullets: Co-founded and led a team of 6 engineers, owning every technical decision from architecture to production.
Shipped the MVP to production in 1 month — mobile app, backend services, and CI/CD (React Native, Laravel, DigitalOcean).

cards.title: This Portfolio
cards.summary: The site you're browsing — a hand-built interactive 3D portfolio.
bullets: Custom three.js particle-network engine written from scratch — depth parallax, idle drift, per-vertex fog, no effect libraries.
Depth-aware grab & pull interaction: pick nodes in screen space, drag them within their own z-layer, and let spring-back physics settle them home.
WCAG-tuned dual themes — toasted-amber light and signature dark — bilingual EN/ES, with prefers-reduced-motion respected end to end.
